claims: The United Football League (UFL) is a professional spring football league.
The UFL was formed by the merger of the XFL and USFL.
The UFL is kicking off its 2026 season with eight teams.
The UFL features 4-point field goals from 60+ yards.
The UFL has no punts inside the opponent's 50-yard line.
UFL games air on ESPN and ABC.
The UFL consists of eight teams.
The UFL teams include newcomers Louisville Kings, Columbus Aviators, and Orlando Storm.
The UFL teams include Birmingham Stallions, Dallas Renegades, DC Defenders, Houston Gamblers, and St. Louis Battlehawks.
Sports Illustrated and the UFL say the UFL is banning the "tush push" play.
Sports Illustrated and the UFL say the UFL is allowing one foot inbounds for catches.
Sports Illustrated and the UFL say the UFL features unique 1-, 2-, or 3-point PAT options.
The UFL partnered with Sportable for official connected ball and player tracking technology.
UFL players earn a $50,000 salary.
UFL players receive a $400 weekly housing stipend.
Numerous players from the 2024 UFL season signed NFL contracts.
The 2026 UFL season schedule includes Birmingham Stallions vs. Louisville Kings on March 27, 2026.
The 2026 UFL season schedule includes DC Defenders vs. St. Louis Battlehawks on March 28, 2026.
The 2026 UFL season schedule includes Houston Gamblers vs. Dallas Renegades on March 28, 2026.
The 2026 UFL season schedule includes Columbus Aviators vs. Orlando Storm on March 29, 2026.
